suggestions.title: Seven of the eight destination pages are orphans
suggestions.detail: Crawling every internal link on all 39 live pages, only /study/uk is linked from anywhere on the site (30 links to it). /study/canada, /study/usa, /study/australia, /study/new-zealand, /study/japan, /study/south-korea and /study/finland are reachable only by URL or via the sitemap, not from any page's prose or navigation. This is the exact failure mode the daily playbook warns about for a page that won't index: nothing links to it. Not fixed today because relinking seven pages properly is the weekly job's scope, not a mechanical one-line fix, but it is likely the single biggest reason any of these pages underperform in search regardless of their content quality.
suggestions.why: An unlinked page is discovered by search engines last and by readers never; this affects seven of the site's highest-intent landing pages at once.

suggestions.title: Two meta descriptions run 1 character over 160 but are also visible page copy
suggestions.detail: /software/enquiry-management-software (161 chars) and the blog post /blog/sop-mistakes-that-get-nepali-students-refused (161 chars) both reuse their metaDescription field as visible card text elsewhere (the /software index and the /blog index), so shortening it for the meta tag would change what a reader sees on those listing pages. Left alone under the rule that a visible change is a suggestion, not a fix.
suggestions.needsYou: A decision on whether to shorten the visible listing copy (a one-character-over meta tag is a very small cost to leave alone).

summary:
Site: up, 200, sitemap valid with 39 URLs.
